description: Android activity class for applying visual effects to images using OpenGL and the Android media effect framework. Manages texture loading, effect initialization, and rendering based on user menu selections.

classes.name: HelloEffects
classes.description: Main activity class for applying and rendering media effects on images using OpenGL ES and Android media effect framework.

methods.name: setCurrentEffect
methods.description: Sets the current visual effect based on user selection.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the GLSurfaceView, and prepares rendering mode.

methods.name: loadTextures
methods.description: Generates textures, loads a bitmap resource, and uploads it to OpenGL texture.

methods.name: initEffect
methods.description: Initializes the selected effect using EffectFactory based on current effect ID.

methods.name: applyEffect
methods.description: Applies the initialized effect to the loaded texture.

methods.name: renderResult
methods.description: Renders the processed or original texture depending on effect selection.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Main rendering loop; initializes context, loads textures, applies effects, and renders frame.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Handles surface size changes, updates renderer view size.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Placeholder for surface creation; no specific implementation.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for effect selection.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection, updates current effect, and requests re-render.
